appDescription: An app for managing rest settings while parked.

function.name: OPEN_REST_SETTINGS
function.description: Open the app screen where the user can review and configure rest settings.

function.name: PREPARE_REST_ALARM
function.description: Open a confirmation to set a vehicle rest alarm for the requested number of minutes.

minutes.description: Whole minutes until the alarm, from 1 to 120.

function.name: OPEN_REST_PLACES
function.description: Search Jarvis for highway rest areas and drowsy-driving shelters by name, road, or direction.

query.description: Name of a highway rest area or drowsy-driving shelter, road, or direction.
